assetStorage: Pinned public dependencies downloaded and verified by Git blob SHA; unmodified source closure
renderRepresentation: Retained continuous original closed yarns and sewn trims

solverAcceptance.tailWorkPolicy: Repair strain only above the unchanged hard limit; stop after fresh same-round strain/contact/body checks all pass; report stricter preferences without chasing them past a valid coupled state

simulationClock: Serial fixed-step timer independent of requestAnimationFrame; unchanged 1/120 s step; no catch-up or omitted physics steps
referenceBodyLoading: Derived unchanged position/index byte ranges from the pinned old reference body; original and runtime geometry SHA-256 checks; no old skin, rig, archive or actor payload is requested

referenceBodyPayload.scope: Only the old coordinate-reference asset, not the current visible native person, total-page traffic or frame rate
